definitions.explanation: A device that stores electrical energy and powers electronics, especially rechargeable batteries in phones and laptops.
In baseball, the combination of pitcher and catcher.

notes:
From English "battery."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- バッテリー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れる→切れる：01936_kireru⟧ (battery dies)
- バッテリー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{充電|じゅうでん}→充電：04427_juuden⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to charge the battery)
- バッテリー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{残量|ざんりょう}→残量：18269_zanryou⟧ (battery level)
- バッテリー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち→持つ：00478_motsu⟧ (battery life)
- ⟦モバイルバッテリー→モバイルバッテリー：07553_mobairubatterii⟧ (portable battery/power bank)

NOTE: For disposable batteries, ⟦{乾電池|かんでんち}→乾電池：10188_kandenchi⟧ is typically used.

BASEBALL: バッテリー refers to the pitcher (⟦{投手|とうしゅ}→投手：06563_toushu⟧) and catcher (⟦{捕手|ほしゅ}→捕手：09265_hoshu⟧) as a pair.
